top_findings.title: Overlapping source files triple-count matches in standings/team_stats/competition_stats
top_findings.evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp.py:147-151 maps Brasileirao_Matches.csv (2012-2022), novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (2003-2019) AND BR-Football-Dataset.csv (matched via _competition_key) all to competition 'Brasileirao'; standings(2019) returns matches_used=1140 and top team Flamengo with matches=114, points=270 (true Serie A season is 38 matches / 90 pts). Aggregates for overlapping seasons are ~3x inflated.
top_findings.suggestion: Deduplicate matches across source files (by date+teams+score) or restrict each competition/season to a single authoritative source before computing standings/stats.
